description: This file contains UI components for a chat interface in an Android app, implemented with Jetpack Compose. It includes composable functions for displaying chat messages, session selectors, error messages, and handling image attachments. The file also manages state and interactions related to sending messages, auto-sending prompts, and selecting images from device storage.

classes.name: PendingImageAttachment
classes.description: Data class representing an image attachment pending upload, including file name, mime type, and base64 data.

methods.name: resolvePendingAssistantAutoSend
methods.description: Determines whether to automatically send a pending assistant prompt based on current conditions.

methods.name: dispatchPendingAssistantAutoSend
methods.description: Executes automatic sending of a pending assistant prompt if conditions are met.

methods.name: ChatSheetContent
methods.description: Composable function rendering the main chat interface with message list, session selector, error display, and input composer.

methods.name: ChatThreadSelector
methods.description: Composable for selecting different chat sessions.

methods.name: ChatErrorRail
methods.description: Displays an error message related to chat issues.
